results.title: Going offline and editing shows a readable save error with "Try again"
More edits while offline are kept in the page (not discarded), other steps usable
"Try again" while still offline keeps the error (no false "saved")
Leaving with unsaved offline edits triggers the browser "unsaved changes" prompt
Back online: "online" event flushes and the indicator returns to "All changes saved"
After recovery a reload shows the offline-typed values (nothing lost)
Offline error auto-retries (about 8 s) once the network returns even without a new edit or the online event
Dashboard while offline shows a readable error (no blank crash)
Creating a new investigation while offline shows an error and does not navigate
Opening an investigation while offline does not claim it is missing/deleted
Network failing during investigation open: page says "not found / deleted" misleadingly? (observed)
Network drop while editing signed in: error shown, edits kept, recovery on reconnect
